description: This file contains Cucumber.js hooks for setting up and tearing down browser instances in end-to-end tests. It defines 'Before' and 'After' hooks to initialize and dispose of browser resources, respectively, with a custom timeout setting.

methods.name: Before
methods.description: A hook executed before each test scenario to initialize shared browser context if needed.

methods.name: After
methods.description: A hook executed after each test scenario to clean up browser resources.
